veranderings.voor: Die res van hierdie les kyk na elkeen van die drie.
veranderings.na: In die res van hierdie les kyk ons na elkeen van die drie.
veranderings.rede: A lesson that 'looks at' something is an English construction; Afrikaans makes the people the subject.

veranderings.voor: Die blou is water en dit
veranderings.na: Die blou is water, en dit
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: bedek die meeste van die Aarde se oppervlak
veranderings.na: bedek die grootste deel van die Aarde se oppervlak
veranderings.rede: 'Die meeste van' suits countable things; for one surface 'die grootste deel van' is the natural Afrikaans with the same meaning.

veranderings.voor: Al hierdie water is sout en jy
veranderings.na: Al hierdie water is sout, en jy
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: naby Kaapstad en 'n boot kan heeltemal daarom vaar
veranderings.na: naby Kaapstad, en 'n boot kan heeltemal om die eiland vaar
veranderings.rede: A Grade 4 reader takes 'daarom' as 'therefore'; naming the island makes 'around it' clear, and the AWS comma joins two full clauses.

veranderings.voor: land in die water en 'n meer
veranderings.na: land in die water, en 'n meer
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Jy kan lug nie sien nie maar jy
veranderings.na: Jy kan lug nie sien nie, maar jy
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'maar' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Nêrens hou dit skielik op nie en daar
veranderings.na: Nêrens hou dit skielik op nie, en daar
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: haal asem met die lug in hierdie dun laag
veranderings.na: asem die lug in hierdie dun laag in
veranderings.rede: 'Haal asem met die lug' is wooden; the separable verb 'inasem' says the same thing naturally.
Land, water and air do not 'make' places; 'vorm' is the natural verb with the same meaning.
AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('lewe daar ... dinge').

veranderings.voor: Die buitekant van iets wat jy kan sien en aanraak.
veranderings.na: Die buitekant van iets, die deel wat jy kan sien en aanraak.
veranderings.rede: As written 'wat jy kan sien en aanraak' attaches to 'iets' (a thing you can touch) rather than to the outside part; the change makes the relative clause refer to the outside.

vlae.blok: Die Aarde is 'n bal met rots aan die buitekant
vlae.teks: Breek 'n stuk van 'n berg af en jy hou harde rots vas.
vlae.rede: Imperative plus a full clause joined by 'en'; the imperative has no expressed subject, so it is unclear whether the AWS comma rule applies. Left unchanged; a person may decide.
